scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 18 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

scenicChapters.title: Passo di Giau · Dolomites
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 82 km this is Passo di Giau · Dolomites, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

places-puez-odle-puez-geisler-poz-odles-.story: 295 km from Selva to Selva, about 5 h 05 of riding. On the way it passes Dolomiti Friulane e d`Oltre Piave, Le Colline del Prosecco di Conegliano e Va and back through Dolomiti Friulane e d`Oltre Piave. The highest point is about 1,850 m. The line favours views over speed.
